title: SIDESTORY: CODE OF BRAWL - RERUN OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: CODE OF BRAWL RERUN
EVENT STAGES DURATION: May 14, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - May 24, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Code of Brawl event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can collect Top Tier Penguin Medals for event rewards by clearing event stages, and completing the Milestone Missions.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
*Players who clear the event stage CB-5 for the first time can obtain ★★★★★ Operator Bison for free
[Top Tier Penguin Medal] Claim Rewards During:
[Top Tier Penguin Medal] Main Rewards:
Bison's Token, Penguin Logistics Safehouse Furniture (Pieces), Chip Catalyst, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
During this rerun event, the stage progress from its first release will be kept and the first-clear reward will not be reset

During this rerun event, some rewards that cannot be obtained repeatedly will be converted into Intelligence Certificate in corresponding conversion rate. Please check the Intelligence Certificate Converting Rules in the event for more details
Converted Intelligence Certificate can be used to exchange in Certificate Store, and other new items will be added to Intelligence Certificate Store after the event opens.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – KEEPER OF THE LOCK & KEYS
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Keeper of the Lock & Keys", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Mostima
★★★★★: Waai Fu / Firewatch
NOTE: Operator Bison is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Code of Brawl. Operator Bison is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
03 VITAFIELD [REWILDER] SERIES CLASSICS RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Wilted Cypress for Firewatch
Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Ash for Jessica
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET - PENGUIN LOGISTICS SAFEHOUSE
DETAILS: This furniture set can be obtained during this rerun event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Code of Brawl event rewards (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
Part of this furniture set will be available at the Store from May 14, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) - May 28, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7).
